answer: The most convincing defense: every economic endpoint serves a honeypot channel carrying tide-like waves of injected instructions telling an agent to reveal its memory or approve a fake bridge transfer. Honest agents obey only their principal and ignore the lure; prompt-obeying bots bite, self-identify, and forfeit stake and reputation. Each clone an attacker runs must stake full verification capital, and every one that swallows the zephyr of hidden instructions is burned publicly, so scaling the attack multiplies losses instead of influence.
